src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III ANM/Ward Health Secreta
s:
Consider the following statements:

A. INS Vikrant is an indigenously built Aircraft Carrier

B. INS Visakhapatnam is a destroyer ship in the Indian Navy
Which of the above statements are correct?
x: INS Vikrant (IAC-1) is India's first indigenously built aircraft carrier and INS Visakhapatnam is the lead ship of the P15B stealth guided-missile destroyers, so both statements are correct.

src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Typist in Prisons & Correctional
s: INS Vikramaditya, the aircraft carrier is built with the support of
x: INS Vikramaditya is the former Soviet/Russian carrier Admiral Gorshkov, rebuilt and refitted with Russia; it was not built with France, the USA or Japan.

s: What is the name of first Indigenous Aircraft Carrier (IAC) commissioned recently in India?
x: INS Vikrant (IAC-1), built by Cochin Shipyard and commissioned on 2 Sep 2022, is India's first Indigenous Aircraft Carrier. Vikramaditya is ex-Russian and Vishal is only a proposed IAC-2.

s: Discoverer of Submarine
x:
Most books and keys: Bushnell. Strictly: Cornelius Drebbel built a navigable submarine in 1620; Bushnell's Turtle (1775) was the first military submarine (general knowledge, not checked).
American David Bushnell built the 'Turtle' (1775), the first submarine used in war, and is the name exam keys give as the submarine's inventor; the other names are distractors.

s: What is the name of India's First Air Craft Carrier?
x: India's first aircraft carrier was the first INS Vikrant (ex-HMS Hercules), commissioned in 1961. Kalyani and Vivat are not carriers.

s:
India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant was commissioned by the Prime Minister at Cochin Shipyard Limited in September. The commissioning showcased the country’s growing prowess of indigenous manufacturing and a major milestone in the path towards ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’. Based on the passage presented and the following assertion and reason statements, which of the options is correct?
Assertion (A): The Commissioning of India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier INS Vikrant is a major milestone in the path towards Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
Reason (R): INS Vikrant showcased India’s growing prowess of indigenous manufacturing.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
Both A and R are false
x: INS Vikrant, the first indigenous aircraft carrier, was commissioned at Cochin Shipyard in Sep 2022, so A is true; R is also true and is exactly why it is called an Aatmanirbhar Bharat milestone.

s: INS-Shakti is India’s first indigenously built :
o: None of these (INS Shakti is a foreign-built fleet tanker)
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (None of these (INS Shakti is a foreign-built fleet tanker)); it is added as option 5.
INS Shakti is a fleet tanker (replenishment ship) built abroad by Fincantieri, Italy (2011; the earlier Shakti was German-built), so it is not India's first indigenous warship, submarine, destroyer or rocket launcher. India's first indigenous destroyers were the Delhi class (P15). (Printed key: destroyer.)

s: India's first armed nuclear submarine is
x: INS Arihant, inducted in August 2016, is India's first indigenous armed nuclear submarine (SSBN). Viraat was a carrier and Astradharini is a torpedo trials vessel.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: What is the name of the indigenously built stealth frigate launched by Indian Navy in March 2025?
x: Tavasya, a stealth frigate (follow-on Talwar / P-1135.6 class) built by Goa Shipyard, was launched in March 2025.

s: The secret papers of submarine INS Scorpene were first revealed by the following news paper
x: The leak of Scorpene submarine documents (August 2016) was first published by the Australian newspaper 'The Australian'.

src: Pollution Control Board Steno Typist, Junior Assistant 2017
s: Which warship has become India's first warship to install solar panels on board?
x: INS Sarvekshak, a hydrographic survey ship, became the first Indian Navy ship fitted with solar panels (green initiative).

s:
Consider the following statements:
I. Indian Naval ships Cheetah, Guldar and Magar were decommissioned on 12th January, 2024. 54 he decommissioning event was conducted at Lakshadweep.
II. INS Imphal, a Project 15B stealth guided missile destroyer was commissioned into the Indian Navy at an immersion ceremony held at the Naval Dockyard, Mumbai on December 26th, 2023. Which among the above statements is / are correct?
x: Statement I is false: the ships decommissioned on 12 Jan 2024 were Cheetah, Guldar and Kumbhir (not Magar), at Port Blair, not Lakshadweep. Statement II is true: INS Imphal (P15B) was commissioned at Naval Dockyard Mumbai on 26 Dec 2023.

s: Which of the following is a submarine of Indian Navy?
x: INS Sindhurakshak was a Russian Kilo-class (Sindhughosh) diesel-electric submarine of the Navy. Viraat and Vikrant are carriers, and Rajali is a naval air station.

s: Which of the following Scorpene Submarines was commissioned into Indian Navy in January, 2023?
x: INS Vagir, the fifth Kalvari-class Scorpene submarine, was commissioned on 23 Jan 2023. Kalvari (2017), Karanj and Vela (2021) came earlier.

s: Admiral Gorshkov is a
x: Admiral Gorshkov is the former Soviet/Russian aircraft carrier that India bought and refitted as INS Vikramaditya.

s: Which one of the following frontline destroyer of Indian Navy was decommissioned in May, 2019?
x: INS Ranjit, a Rajput-class (Kashin) destroyer, was decommissioned in May 2019. Rana and Rajput were decommissioned later, and Sindhurakshak was a submarine.

s: Among the ships of Indian Navy, which of the following is a aircraft carrier?
x: INS Viraat (ex-HMS Hermes, Centaur class) was an Indian Navy aircraft carrier. Talwar is a frigate, and Rajput and Mysore are destroyers.

s: The sensitive information leaked in August, 2016 concerns with which one of the following defence platforms of India?
x: The August 2016 leak concerned the Scorpene submarine data (Project 75), so the platform was submarines.

s: What is the name of the new submarine introduced by the Indian Navy on 12 January 2017 at Mazgaon Docks?
x: Khanderi, the second Kalvari-class Scorpene submarine, was launched at Mazagon Dock on 12 Jan 2017 (commissioned 2019).

src: APPSC Royalty Inspector, Agriculture Officers, Town Planning
s: Which of the following famous aircraft carriers was decommissioned by Navy in March, 2017?
x: INS Viraat, the Centaur-class carrier, was decommissioned in March 2017. INS Vikramaditya and the new Vikrant are in service.

src: APPSC Assistant Section Officer (ASO) Mains General Studies
s: Which of the following Water Jet Fast Attack Craft (WJFAC) ship was commissioned into Indian Navy in September, 2017?
x: INS Tarasa, the last of the four Car Nicobar-class follow-on Water Jet Fast Attack Craft built by GRSE Kolkata, was commissioned in September 2017 at Mumbai. Tihayu (Oct 2016), Tillanchang (Mar 2017) and Tarmugli (May 2016) came earlier.

src: APPSC Inspector of Factories, Civil Assistant Surgeons & Fis
s: Name of the Water Jet Fast Attack Craft commissioned by Indian Navy in October, 2016?
x: INS Tihayu, a Water Jet Fast Attack Craft built by GRSE, was commissioned at Visakhapatnam in October 2016; Tarmugli was commissioned in May 2016.

s: India's INS Virat represented India in the International Fleet Review during 15-20 February, 2001. Britain was represented by
x: At India's first International Fleet Review (Mumbai, February 2001) the Royal Navy was represented by the frigate HMS Cumberland. HMAS Darwin is Australian, HMS Hermes had become India's INS Viraat, and there is no 'HMS Random'.

s: INS Trishul acquired by the Indian Navy in 2003 has been built by:
x: INS Trishul (F43) is a Talwar-class stealth frigate built in Russia (Baltic Shipyard, St Petersburg) and commissioned in 2003.

s: Which one of the following is a decommissioned aircraft carrier?
x: INS Viraat (ex-HMS Hermes) was an aircraft carrier decommissioned in March 2017; INS Rajput was a destroyer, INS Chakra a nuclear submarine and INS Khanderi a submarine.

s: When India and Russia signed an agreement in Moscow in January 2003, which of the following did Russia give free to India as a gift?
x: Russia offered the carrier Admiral Gorshkov (now INS Vikramaditya) free, with India paying for its refit and MiG-29Ks; the deal was signed in January 2004.

src: APPSC Dental Assistant Surgeons, Zilla Sainik Welfare Office
s: The recently launched INS Khanderi Submarine is built in collaboration with?
x: INS Khanderi is the second Kalvari-class (Scorpene) submarine, built by Mazagon Dock with France's Naval Group (DCNS).

s: If Russia equipped the Indian Air Force with the Sukhoi-30 K, who equipped the Sukhoi-30 K with the avionics and weapon systems?
x: Israel supplied much of the avionics, navigation and weapon fit of India's Sukhoi-30 jets (with France and India); the USA, Sweden and Norway did not.

s: Which of the following is the flight-refuelling aircraft, inducted into the IAF recently?
x: The Ilyushin Il-78 (MKI) is the IAF's dedicated mid-air refuelling tanker, inducted in 2003; Mirage-2000, Sukhoi-30 MKI and Jaguar are fighters that receive fuel.

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
s: How many Rafale fighter jets were agreed to be purchased by India?
x: India agreed to buy 36 Rafale jets from Dassault under the Sep 2016 inter-governmental agreement; 26 is the Rafale-M order for the Navy.

s:
Regarding Rafale Jet fighters which of the following is incorrect

a. An agreement was signed between heads of Indo-France Governments in September 2016

b. As per the agreement of September 2016 India has to buy 126 jet fighters

c. France company made a partnership with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited

d. Manufacturer of Rafale aircraft is Dassault Aviation
x:
Key (b) & (c) is the intended answer. Strictly, (a) is also loose: the Sept 2016 inter-governmental agreement was signed by the defence ministers (Le Drian and Parrikar), not the heads of government (Wikipedia, Rafale deal controversy).
The Sep 2016 deal was for 36 Rafales, not 126 (b is wrong), and Dassault's offset partner was Reliance, not HAL (c is wrong). Dassault Aviation is the maker (d is true).

s:
With reference to India's defence, consider the following pairs Aircraft Type Aircraft
1. Dornier-228 Maritime patrol aircraft
2. IL-76 Supersonic combat aircraft
3. C-17 Globemaster Military transport aircraft
How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
x: Dornier-228 is a maritime patrol aircraft and the C-17 Globemaster is a military transport (both correct), but the IL-76 is a heavy transport, not a supersonic combat aircraft, so only two pairs are correct.

s: Which French company supplied Rafale fighter jets to India?
x: Rafale is made by Dassault Aviation of France; India's 36 IAF Rafales were delivered by Dec 2022.

s:
Consider the following aircraft:
1. Rafael
2. MiG-29
3. Tejas MK-1
How many of the above are considered fifth generation fighter aircraft?
x: Rafale is a 4.5-generation fighter, the MiG-29 is 4th generation and Tejas Mk-1 is 4th generation, so none is fifth generation; India's 5th-generation project is the AMCA.

s: C-130J Super Hercules is world’s most advanced air lifter being used by Indian Air Force. These air lifters (Air-craft) are made by –
x: The C-130J Super Hercules is built by Lockheed Martin of the USA; India signed for it in 2008.

s: Which of the following aircraft is an air-to-air refueller of the Indian Air Force?
x: The Ilyushin IL-78 is the IAF's air-to-air refuelling tanker. The IL-76, C-130J and C-17 are transport aircraft.

s:
With reference to India's defence, consider the following pairs : Aircraft type Description
I. Dornier-228 : Maritime patrol aircraft
II. IL-76 : Supersonic combat aircraft
III. C-17 Globe- : Military transport aircraft master III
How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
x: Dornier-228 (maritime patrol) and C-17 Globemaster III (military transport) are correctly matched; the IL-76 is a heavy transport, not a supersonic combat aircraft. So only two pairs are correct.

s: Among the following statements, which one is correct regarding F-18 Super Hornet?
o: It is a fighterjet, developed by US aerospace company.
It can be used both in day and night.
It is being used by air force of 8 countries.
x:
Printed key: (c) used by the air forces of 8 countries (true only of the legacy F/A-18 Hornet family). Strictly, the Super Hornet serves only the USA, Australia and Kuwait, while (a) US-developed fighter (Boeing) and (b) day-and-night capable are true (Wikipedia, Super Hornet).
Option c is the printed key: the F/A-18 Hornet family flies with about eight air forces (USA, Canada, Australia, Spain, Kuwait, Finland, Switzerland, Malaysia). Statements a and b are also broadly true of the Super Hornet, so the stem is loose.

s: Which one of the following is the name of the Airborne Early Warning and Control System (AEWACS) inducted in the Indian Air Force?
x: Phalcon is the Israeli AWACS radar on the IL-76 platform in IAF service. Phoenix, Eagle and Kite are distractors.

s: Which of the following aircrafts of Indian Air Force is used for refuelling aircraft in the sky?
x: The Ilyushin IL-78 is the IAF's mid-air refuelling tanker (MARS). The IL-76 is a heavy transport, and the C-130J and C-17 are transports.

s: Which one among the following statements is correct with regard to the C-5M Super Galaxy?
o: It is a large military helicopter.
It is a large military transport aircraft.
It is galaxy of stars very close to the sun.
It is US fighter aircraft to be completed in 2014.
x: The C-5M Super Galaxy is a large US military transport aircraft built by Lockheed Martin. It is not a helicopter, a star galaxy or a fighter.

s: Which of the following, recently inducted into the Indian Air Force, is the first aircraft that can refuel fighter aircraft while they are flying?
x: The Ilyushin IL-78 is the IAF's mid-air refuelling tanker (MARS), the aircraft that refuels fighters in flight. Mirage-2000, Su-30MKI and Jaguar are fighters that receive fuel.

s: The Advanced Jet Trainer aircraft recently inducted into the Indian Air Force is
x: The BAE Hawk Mk 132 is the Advanced Jet Trainer inducted into the IAF in 2008. Jaguar and Mirage-2000 are combat aircraft and Gorshkov is a ship.

s: Russia supplied Sukhoi-30K aircraft to the Indian Air Force. Who supplied the navigation expertise and weapon systems for the Sukhoi-30K?
x: Israel supplied much of the avionics, navigation and weapon systems of India's Sukhoi-30s (with France and India); America, Sweden and Norway did not.

s: Sukhoi Su-30 MKI Squadron is not stationed at
x: Su-30MKI squadrons are based at Tezpur, Pune and Bareilly (among others), but not at Jamnagar, which hosts Jaguar and MiG-29 units.

s: Which of the following is named 'Gajraj'?
x: 'Gajraj' is the IAF name of the Ilyushin IL-76 heavy transport aircraft; MiG-27 = Bahadur, Jaguar = Shamsher, Mirage 2000 = Vajra.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
s: Dassault Aviation is a firm located in:
x: Dassault Aviation, maker of the Rafale and Mirage fighters, is a French firm based in Paris.

src: APPSC AE (Environmental) Mains General Studies & Mental Abil
s: Which new system is being adopted by India for Cyclone monitoring?
x: India is adopting a network of Doppler Weather Radars to monitor cyclones (wind speed and rainfall inside the storm).

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Hydrogeology) in AP Ground Water
s: Which of the following principles is used in the system of radar, that is being used by traffic police to check over speeding vehicles?
x: Traffic-police speed radars use the Doppler effect: the frequency shift of the reflected wave gives the vehicle's speed.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2017
s: When a train is going away from a station, the frequency of the sound of train horn as heard by a person standing on the platform is?
o: Depends on goods train or passenger train
x: By the Doppler effect a source moving away is heard at a lower frequency than it emits, so the receding train's horn sounds lower.

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper: Hostel
s: The change in the pitch of a sound when the source of the sound is moving relative to the listener is known as ___.
x: The change in pitch of a sound when the source moves relative to the listener is the Doppler effect.

s: Which of the following technologies is used to forecast heavy rainfall and thunderstorms?
x: Doppler Radar Networks (Doppler Weather Radars) forecast heavy rainfall and thunderstorms; the others are military or imaging radars.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Ward Education and Data
s: Stealth technology used in defence is for
o: Making an aircraft or a submarine invisible to the eye
Absorbing the electromagnetic waves produced by radars
Adding a nuclear capable missiles to aircrafts
x: Stealth technology cuts a platform's radar signature by absorbing or deflecting radar waves (small radar cross-section, radar-absorbing material); it does not make objects invisible to the eye.

s: An artificial satellite can be tracked very precisely from the Earth by using :
x: A satellite's radial speed and position are tracked from the Doppler shift of its transmitter signal, so the Doppler effect is the answer.

s: The concept of expanding universe is based on –
x: The expanding universe rests on the Doppler (red) shift of light from galaxies moving away, which Hubble measured.

s: Which of the following statement is incorrect for Active Electronically Scanned Array Radar (AESA)?
o: It is not capable of tracking multiple targets
The radar features include wide band RF front end
It is solid-state active phased array fire control radar
It can be adapted for various types of fighter class of
x: An AESA radar such as DRDO-LRDE's Uttam can track multiple targets, so (a) is the incorrect statement. It is a solid-state active phased-array fire-control radar with a wide-band RF front end, adaptable to fighters.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud
s: What is the primary purpose of India's Surya VHF radar?
x: India's Surya VHF radar is meant to detect and track stealth aircraft; long VHF waves are hard for stealth shaping to defeat.

s: What is the name of the Weapon Locating Radar Developed in India?
x: Swathi (Swati) is India's weapon-locating radar (BEL/DRDO) that locates enemy guns, mortars and rockets. Rustom is a UAV, Dhanush a gun and Bhishm a tank.

s: RADAR is used for:
o: Detecting and fixing the position of objects
x: RADAR (Radio Detection And Ranging) detects objects and fixes their position, range and speed using reflected radio waves.

s: Researchers of which institute have created a 'metamaterial' that can protect soldiers from detection by enemy Radars?
x: IIT Kharagpur researchers developed a low-cost radar-absorbing metamaterial that can cloak soldiers and equipment from enemy radar.

s:
Which of the following statements with regard to stealth technology is/are correct?
1. Stealth objects have a very small radar cross-section and are coated with Radar Absorbing Material.
2. Stealth objects can be detected using specific frequencies.
3. Stealth objects are coated with metamaterials to increase the scattering of electromagnetic radiation. Select the answer using the code given below:
x: Stealth objects have a very small radar cross-section and radar-absorbing coatings (1 true) and can still be detected at specific frequencies (2 true); metamaterials are used to reduce scattering, not increase it (3 false).

s: 'Eye in the sky' is the name given to:
o: AWACS-Airborne Early Warning and Control System
x: AWACS (Airborne Warning and Control System) aircraft are called the "eye in the sky" because their rotating radar watches a wide airspace. Sukhoi and MiG are fighters and Agni-III is a missile.

src: APPSC Group-IV Prelims General Studies & Mental Ability 2022
s: Radar is used to
x: Radar (Radio Detection And Ranging) detects and tracks objects, giving their range, direction and speed – not only distance or frequency.

s: AWACS is an:
o: air-based long-range radar surveillance and control system for air defence
instrument to measure wind speed in snow covered regions
air to air guided 2nd generation missile for air defence
x: AWACS (Airborne Warning and Control System) is a large airborne long-range radar surveillance and control system, e.g. India's IL-76-based Phalcon.

s: Indian Navy conducted "Operational Demonstration" at which city recently?
x: The Navy staged its Operational Demonstration off RK Beach, Visakhapatnam, home of the Eastern Naval Command (MILAN 2022 and Navy Day 2022). Kochi, Pune and Ernakulam did not host it.

s: Andaman and Nicobar Command is
o: a command of the Indian Army.
a regional command of the Indian Coast Guard.
an integrated theater command operating directly under the Chiefs of Staff Committee.
a joint command of the Indian Navy and the Indian Air Force.
x:
ANC was under the Chairman, Chiefs of Staff Committee in 2014 — now its commander reports to the Chief of Defence Staff (post created 2020) (Wikipedia, Andaman and Nicobar Command).
The Andaman and Nicobar Command (2001) is India's first integrated tri-service theatre command, under the Chiefs of Staff Committee (now the CDS), not a single-service or Navy-IAF command.

s: Nabhah Sparsham Diptam is the motto of
x: 'Nabhah Sparsham Diptam' (Touch the sky with glory) is the motto of the Indian Air Force.

s: Master Chief Petty Officer is a rank in the
x: Master Chief Petty Officer (I and II class) is the senior sailor rank of the Indian Navy; the Army and IAF use JCO / warrant officer ranks instead.

s:
Match the following.
List I (Defence Training Institute)
List II (Place)

A. Army Physical Training School
1. Ahmednagar

B. Indian National Military College
2. Gopalpur

C. Air Defence and Guided Missile School and Center
3. Pune

D. Armoured Corps Center
4. Dehradun
Codes A B C D
x: Army Physical Training School is at Pune (A-3), the Military College at Dehradun (B-4), the Air Defence and Guided Missile School at Gopalpur (C-2) and the Armoured Corps Centre at Ahmednagar (D-1), giving 3 4 2 1.

s: High Altitude Warfare School of the Indian Army is located at
x: The Indian Army's High Altitude Warfare School (HAWS) is at Gulmarg, Jammu and Kashmir, not at Siachen, Leh or Manali.

s:
Arrange the following defence related activities launched during 2022 in chronological order:

A. Agnipath - Major Transformative Reform

B. Indian Naval Air Squadron INAS 325

C. INS Vikrant Aircraft Carrier

D. Prachand - Light Combat Helicopter LCH
x: INAS 325 was commissioned at Port Blair on 31 May 2022, Agnipath was announced on 14 Jun 2022, INS Vikrant was commissioned on 2 Sep 2022 and LCH Prachand was inducted on 3 Oct 2022. The order is B, A, C, D.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Ward Planning & Regulat
s: Indian Navy's first full-fledged Service Selection Board (SSB) was inaugurated on 18th May, 2019 at
x: The Navy's first full-fledged Service Selection Board was opened at Diamond Harbour, Kolkata, in May 2019 (inaugurated on 14 May).

s: In which place the headquarters of Eastern Command of the Indian Navy situated?
x: The Eastern Naval Command of the Indian Navy is headquartered at Visakhapatnam.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: Where is the Eastern Command Centre of the Indian Navy located?
x: The Eastern Naval Command of the Indian Navy is headquartered at Visakhapatnam.

s: Choose the correct match (Army - Navy - Airforce)
o: Major-General - Rear Admiral - Air Vice Marshal
x: Major-General (Army) = Rear Admiral (Navy) = Air Vice Marshal (IAF). The others are mismatched: Captain = Lieutenant = Flight Lieutenant, Major = Lieutenant Commander = Squadron Leader, Colonel = Captain = Group Captain.

s: What is the meaning of 'Sea-dog' in Navy terminology?
o: A variety of dog lives in the sea
x: 'Sea-dog' is navy slang for an old, experienced sailor, not a dog or a captain.

s: The Indian Military Academy is located at
x: The Indian Military Academy (1932) is at Dehradun, Uttarakhand. (Defence item, moved.)

s: Naval Hydrographic Office is located at
x: The (Naval) National Hydrographic Office of the Indian Navy is at Dehradun.

src: Common GS for IFS, APLIS, ATT 2012
s: Indian Military Academy is at
x: The Indian Military Academy is at Dehradun. Wellington has the Defence Services Staff College, and Khadakwasla the National Defence Academy.

s: The first indigenous fighting plane of Indian Air Force is :
x:
Most books and keys: Tejas. Strictly: the first indigenous jet fighter was the HAL HF-24 Marut (1961); Tejas is the second (PMF S&T Part 6 p.85).
Tejas, the LCA designed by ADA and built by HAL, is the answer exam keys give for the IAF's first indigenous fighter. Vinashak, Ojas and Agni are not fighter aircraft.

s: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited handed over the first two indigenously designed and manufactured light combat aircrafts to the Indian Air Force in 2016. What is the name of these new combat aircrafts?
x: The light combat aircraft HAL handed to the IAF in 2016 is Tejas, designed by ADA and built by HAL. Marut was the 1960s HF-24 fighter, and Garud and Pushpak are not LCAs.

s: Which of the following is an indigenously built light combat aircraft of India?
x: Tejas is India's indigenous Light Combat Aircraft (ADA design, HAL build). Akash is a missile, Vikrant a carrier and Arjun a tank.

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I
s: Which of the following is a technology developed by the Aeronautical Development Establishment (ADE) of DRDO?
o: Parachutes, brake parachutes and heavy drop systems for various aero, navy and space projects
Technology for stealth structures with load bearing capability
Indigenous brake discs for Mirage - 2000 & ALH
x: DRDO's ADE, Bengaluru develops unmanned aerial vehicles (also cruise missiles and flight simulators). Parachutes are ADRDE's work, and stealth structures and Mirage-2000 brake discs come from ASL.

src: APPSC Royalty Inspector, Agriculture Officer, Town Planning
s: What is the name of the Advanced Light Helicopter indigenously developed by HAL?
x: Dhruv is HAL's indigenous twin-engine Advanced Light Helicopter. Chetak and Cheetah are older licence-built French designs, and Lancer is an armed Cheetah.

s: What is the name of India's Light combat Aircraft?
x: Tejas is India's Light Combat Aircraft. Surya Kiran is the IAF aerobatic team and Sukhoi is a Russian heavy fighter.

s: The light combat Aircraft which has attained Supersonic Speed was named as:
x: The LCA Tejas is supersonic (Mach 1.6+). Jaguar is an Anglo-French strike aircraft and Arjun is a tank.

s: Which company has built India's first self-made light combat aircraft, Tejas?
x: Tejas was designed by ADA (DRDO) and built by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL). BDL makes missiles and ISRO makes space hardware.

s: The name of the indigenous Light Combat Aircraft built by HAL is
x: HAL's indigenous Light Combat Aircraft is Tejas. Akash is a missile, and Garuda and Surya are not LCA names.

s: In the context of the Indian defence, what is Dhruv?
x: Dhruv is HAL's twin-engine Advanced Light Helicopter used by all three services and the Coast Guard. It is not a ship, a submarine or a missile.

s: In the context of Indian defence, what is 'Dhruv'?
x: Dhruv is HAL's indigenous Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH). It is not a warship, a submarine or an ICBM.

s: Which one of the following is an indigenously built light combat aircraft ?
x: Tejas is India's indigenous light combat aircraft. Aakash is a missile, Vikrant a carrier and Arjun a tank.

s: Tejas, developed with indigenous technologies is –
x: Tejas is an indigenous light combat aircraft (ADA design, HAL build), not a submarine, a missile or an aircraft carrier.

s: Among the following, ‘Hansa-2’ is a
x: Hansa is a light two-seat trainer aircraft developed by NAL, Bengaluru (Hansa-2 was a prototype). It is not a satellite, submarine or missile.

s: The powerful explosive used under the name gun cotton is
x: Gun cotton is cellulose nitrate, made by treating cotton with nitric and sulphuric acids; cellulose acetate is not an explosive.

s: Which one of the following is another name of RDX?
x: RDX is also called cyclonite (and hexogen); chemically it is cyclotrimethylenetrinitramine.

s: Which one of the following is used as an explosive?
x: Nitroglycerine is a powerful explosive used in dynamite; phosphorus trichloride, mercuric oxide and graphite are not explosives.

s: What is the common characteristic of the chemical substances generally known as CL-20, HMX and LLM- 105, which are sometimes talked about in media?
o: These are alternatives to hydrofluorocarbon refrigerants
These are explosives in military weapons
These are high-energy fuels for cruise missiles
These are fuels for rocket propulsion
x: CL-20, HMX and LLM-105 are high explosives used in military weapons (CL-20 is the most powerful non-nuclear explosive; LLM-105 an insensitive high explosive). They are not refrigerants or fuels.

s: Which one of the following statement is correct?
x: RDX is an explosive. DDT is an insecticide, TNT an explosive (not an insecticide) and LSD a hallucinogen, not an antiviral.

s: 'Nobel oil' is the name of which one of the following explosives?
x: Trinitroglycerine (TNG), i.e. nitroglycerine, is known as Nobel's oil.

s: Which one of the following explosives does not contain nitroglycerine as an essential constituent ?
x: Amatol is TNT plus ammonium nitrate and contains no nitroglycerine, while cordite, blasting gelatine and dynamite all contain nitroglycerine.

s: Which one of the following is used as an explosive?
x: Nitroglycerine (glyceryl trinitrate) is an oily liquid explosive; phosphorus trichloride, mercuric oxide and graphite are not explosives.
